data.narrative:
MATERIAL is a Seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $7.1M in equity plus $1.25M in USAF SBIR funding. The target sector includes 1 public comparable (Linamar, LNZA) and 8 private peers spanning battery materials, EV supply chain, and energy infrastructure, though no direct same-stage match exists in the narrow peer set.

Given data limitations, valuation relies on stage-progression analysis. Using total raised ($7.1M) as a capital proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A step-ups yields $17.75M. A peer-median approach is not applicable here; while 8 Climate & Energy peers exist, none satisfy same-stage, adjacent-stage, or comparable-valuation-tier filters in sufficient quantity. The comp universe is too sparse and heterogeneous for reliable median-based triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M–$20M, with a median point of $18M. This range reflects uncertainty around (1) the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific sub-sector and stage; (2) the absence of direct Seed-stage peers to validate market pricing; and (3) technology execution risk typical of early-stage hardware ventures. Founder pedigree (ex-Rivian, ex-Mercedes F1 design; PhD battery engineer) and USAF validation provide partial offsets, but do not eliminate the fundamental lack of peer-based corroboration.
